name: smwmusic-touhou-kanjuden-legacy-of-lunatic-kingdom-mother-s-tormented-soul-pure-furies-whereabouts-of-the-heart-remix
title: Touhou Kanjuden ~ Legacy of Lunatic Kingdom - Mother's Tormented Soul ~ Pure Furies ~ Whereabouts of the Heart (Remix)
description:
My mortal enemy, Chang'e. Are you watching?!
Gaze upon this poor soul as she struggles between life and death!

Did an arrangement of Pure Furies ~ Whereabouts of the Heart from Touhou 15: Legacy of the Lunatic Kingdom for Summer C3 2022. This is probs the one song some of my mutuals has been waiting for ever since I showed off a WIP on Twitter dot com. I've been meaning to do Junko's theme ever since I did Junko's stage theme a year back. It also is the hardest and, arguably, the most ambitious port I've done so far ones. I had to really limit myself here in terms of sample usage, which kinda sucked, but I really think it paid off in the end.

Junko's theme is easily one of my favorite final boss themes in this series. It's hella intense and perfectly symbolizes her character as a rageful spirit who lost her son and wants to enact revenge on those who were responsible for his death (Chang'e and her husband).

Important:
♠ "Bonus End" is disabled.

There are also customizable pitches for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
1. C# Minor w/ slight detune (Remix - Listening-Only)
2. C# Minor (Original Pitch, turned on default)
3. C Minor (Custom Pitch)

There are also customizable versions for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
1. Enables Voice Clip, but disables Thunder, P-Switch, & Yoshi (turned on default)
2. Disables Voice Clip
